最后吃饭的人变成了八个。

时笙和四只小鲜肉，苏宜修和方立秋，以及方立秋的经纪人。

方立秋和苏宜修的渊源有点久远，追溯到初中时期，从初中到高中，两人都是同学。只是后来苏宜修先出国，方立秋没多久也跟着出国，可惜两人不在一个国家，自然没什么偶遇。

时笙算是看出来了，这两人多半是互相喜欢的，不然以苏宜修的功力，怎么可能在方立秋说话的时候，只能弱弱的反抗。

“晚姐，立秋姐和那位先生有奸情。”方瑾瑜双眼放光的看着坐在对面的两人。

这两人好配啊！

“要你说，有眼睛的人都看得出来。”姜明白了方瑾瑜一眼。

时笙抿着唇笑，“吃饭。”

感觉以后能甩掉两个包袱了，好开森，本宝宝要多吃点，哈哈哈哈！

吃到一半的时候，苏宜修接了个电话，然后趁方立秋缠着时笙的时候溜出了房间。

等他回来的时候，陆清韵就跟在了他后面。

“小晚儿，陆清韵找你。”苏宜修站在门口冲时笙招手。

他不想进去。

一点也不想！

“哇！好帅！”方瑾瑜最先看到门口的陆清韵，顿时双眼冒桃心，怎么可以有这种帅得不像人的男人。

“小丸子，你竟然背着我找野桃花。”方立秋的反应最大，就差跳起来揍时笙了，“还找一个长得这么好看的，都把你比下去，岂不是他要负责貌美如花，小丸子负责赚钱养家？不要啊！小丸子你不要想不开啊……”

本宝宝也不想想不开啊！

说多了都是泪。

时笙起身走向笑容满满的陆清韵，“有事？”

陆清韵看了眼苏宜修，苏宜修苦逼的退回房间，顺便将门关上，隔绝里面的视线。

“和我去见个人。”

打死时笙她也没想到，陆清韵带自己见的人是陆老爷子。

In the end there were eight people eating.

Shi Sheng and the four little fresh meats, Su Yixiu and Fang Liqiu, and Fang Liqiu's manager.

Fang Liqiu and Su Yixiu have a long history, dating back to their junior high school days. From junior high school to high school, they were classmates.It was just that Su Yixiu went abroad first, and Fang Liqiu followed him soon after. Unfortunately, they were not in the same country, so they naturally didn't encounter each other by chance.

Shi Sheng finally figured out that the two people probably liked each other. Otherwise, with Su Yixiu's skills, how could he only resist weakly when Fang Liqiu spoke.

"Sister Wan, Sister Liqiu is having an affair with that gentleman." Fang Jinyu looked at the two people sitting across from her with bright eyes.

These two are so well matched!

"If you tell me, anyone with eyes can see it." Jiang understood Fang Jinyu.

Shi Sheng pursed her lips and smiled, "Eat."

I feel like I can get rid of two burdens in the future. It’s so exciting. My baby needs to eat more, hahahaha!

Halfway through the meal, Su Yixiu answered the phone and slipped out of the room while Fang Liqiu was pestering Shi Sheng.

When he came back, Lu Qingyun followed him.

"Xiao Wan'er, Lu Qingyun is looking for you." Su Yixiu stood at the door and waved to Shi Sheng.

He didn't want to go in.

Not at all!

"Wow! So handsome!" Fang Jinyu was the first to see Lu Qingyun at the door, and her eyes suddenly filled with tears. How could there be such an inhumanly handsome man?

"Xiao Wanzi, you are actually looking for wild peach blossoms behind my back." Fang Liqiu had the biggest reaction. He almost jumped up and beat Shi Sheng. "To find someone so good-looking and compare yourself to you, wouldn't it mean that he is responsible for being as beautiful as a flower, and Xiao Wanzi is responsible for making money to support the family? No! Xiao Wanzi, don't get carried away..."

This baby can’t even think about it!

Talking too much brings tears.

Shi Sheng stood up and walked towards the smiling Lu Qingyun, "Is something wrong?"

Lu Qingyun glanced at Su Yixiu, who returned to the room bitterly and closed the door to block the view inside.

"Go meet someone with me."

When she was beaten to death, she did not expect that the person Lu Qingyun took her to see was Mr. Lu.
